caption: The drawing is a top-down, plan view of a property divided into two main sections with pathways and vegetation. On the left side, there is a rectangular plot featuring two large, square, gray-roofed buildings aligned vertically, surrounded by manicured green lawns, garden beds with geometric patterns, circular bushes, and decorative trees. Along the left edge, there is a rectangular grid of brown and green, possibly representing garden plots or fields, with a single tree beside it. A rectangular gray structure sits along the top-center edge. The right side of the property is bordered by a curving pathway lined with small pink, white, and green plants and interspersed with regularly spaced round green bushes and taller green conical trees. Towards the top right, there is a large, gray hexagonal platform on which stands a human figure dressed in a red jacket, cream pants, black boots, and a blue cap, raising one hand. The entire property is enclosed by a white picket fence at the bottom edge. The background of the layout is beige, and the vegetation areas are primarily green, with colorful floral detailing along the paths and beds. The title at the bottom reads "THE GEORGE TAYLOR PROPERTY - THE BLACKWELL SURVEY 1860."
title: George Taylor - 2 Residences
